title: Oldest sister's death and fetching her children from San Diego
summary: His oldest sister died in San Diego around 1928-29 while he played Radio City; his mother fetched her two girls, Johanna and Delores.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: And anyway, that's the youngest sister. The oldest sister died in 1928 or 1929- she died. I was playing at the Radio City Music Hall the time she died. She died in San Diego. I had to send my mother to San Diego to get the two kids -- Johanna and Délores, her two children, my oldest sister's two children. I had to send my mother there to get them.
